summary: Turns a voice into MIDI and lets it pass through (monitor blend 0 to 100 %). Pitch: the sung note, locked to a key or scale, with stickiness, octave shift, pitch bend (free or anchored), dynamic or fixed velocity, minimum note length and legato. Triggers: up to 8 sounds you train in one pass (voice percussion or any short sound) play notes at once with the pitch. Chords: diatonic chords that follow the sung root, with suggestions that fit the melody. Expression: the voice level and the vowels aa, oo and ee as MIDI controllers, each with thresholds, range and channel. The MIDI goes to a target machine, to an external MIDI device, and is a MIDI From source for armed tracks. Use it to play synths and drums with your voice, or to sing a melody into a clip.
use_for: Play a synth or drums with your voice: sung pitch to notes in a key, trained beatbox sounds to drum notes, chords, and voice level and vowels as controllers.

parameters.name: Monitor
parameters.description: Dry voice at the output: 0 is silent, 100 % is the input as it came
parameters.how: Sets how much of the dry voice reaches the output, from 0% (silent) to 100% (as it came in).
parameters.sound: At 0% you hear only what the synth plays from the MIDI; a little dry voice makes a guide to sing against.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Voice range: Low latency (about 8 ms, from 100 Hz) or Quality (about 18 ms, from 70 Hz)
parameters.how: Chooses the pitch analysis: Low latency (about 8 ms, from 100 Hz) or Quality (about 18 ms, from 70 Hz).
parameters.sound: Low latency answers sooner but can wobble on low voices; Quality is steadier and reaches lower notes.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The quietest voice that plays a note: under this level the pitch is not read
parameters.how: Sets the quietest voice level, from -70 to -20 dB, that plays a note.
parameters.sound: Raising it ignores room noise and breath; set too high it misses soft singing.

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.description: The sung pitch plays notes
parameters.how: Switches the sung pitch playing notes on or off.
parameters.sound: Off leaves the triggers, the chords and the controllers running without single notes.

parameters.name: Lock
parameters.description: Off: every semitone. Set key: the Root and Scale. Song key: the key of the song (the song's Key entry), else Root and Scale. Suggest: the key found from the notes you sang so far
parameters.how: Chooses how notes are kept to a key: Off, the Root and Scale, the song's key or a key found from what you sang.
parameters.sound: Locked notes land on the key whatever the voice does; Off follows every semitone you sing.

parameters.name: Root
parameters.description: The key's root note
parameters.how: Sets the key's root note from C to B.
parameters.sound: It moves every in-key note with it; the scale keyboard shows the result.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: The scale the voice is locked to
parameters.how: Chooses the scale of the key from 14 choices, including a Custom set of notes.
parameters.sound: Major sounds bright, minor darker, pentatonic and blues leave out the notes that clash.

parameters.name: Custom notes
parameters.description: The notes of the Custom scale, one bit per note from C (bit 0) to B (bit 11)
parameters.how: Holds the Custom scale's twelve notes, one bit each from C to B.
parameters.sound: Only the notes you switch on in the keyboard can play when Scale is Custom.

parameters.name: Muted notes
parameters.description: Notes never played, one bit per note from C to B: the voice goes to the nearest note that is on
parameters.how: Holds the notes that never play, one bit each from C to B (click a key on the keyboard).
parameters.sound: A muted note is replaced by the nearest note that is on, so the melody avoids it.

parameters.name: Octave
parameters.description: Octave shift of the pitch notes
parameters.how: Shifts the pitch notes by whole octaves, from -3 to +3.
parameters.sound: The same tune plays higher or lower on the synth without singing in another register.

parameters.name: Stickiness
parameters.description: How far past the middle between two notes the voice must go before the note changes (a hysteresis)
parameters.how: Sets how far past the middle between two notes the voice must go before the note changes, from 0 to 100 cents.
parameters.sound: More stickiness holds a wobbly note steady; none follows every small move.

parameters.name: Settle
parameters.description: How long a new note must be held before it plays or replaces the one sounding
parameters.how: Sets how long a new note must be held before it plays or replaces the one sounding, from 0 to 200 ms.
parameters.sound: Longer settling removes grace notes and slides at the cost of a later note start.

parameters.name: Pitch bend
parameters.description: Pitch bend range: the voice's distance from the note is sent as bend. Set the same range on the synth
parameters.how: Sets the pitch bend range from off to plus or minus 12 semitones.
parameters.sound: The voice's distance from its note moves the synth's pitch by this much; set the synth to the same range.

parameters.name: Bend mode
parameters.description: Free: bend follows every wobble. Anchored: the note stays put until the voice moves farther than the Anchor from its middle, then it bends
parameters.how: Chooses Free bend or Anchored bend.
parameters.sound: Free follows every wobble; Anchored keeps the note still until the voice leaves it, then bends.

parameters.name: Anchor
parameters.description: Anchored bend: how far from the note's middle the voice must move before the bend starts
parameters.how: Sets how far from the note's middle the voice must move, from 5 to 100 cents, before the bend starts.
parameters.sound: A larger anchor keeps vibrato from bending the note; a small one bends at once.

parameters.name: Velocity
parameters.description: Dynamic: from how loud you sing the note. Fixed: always the Fixed velocity
parameters.how: Chooses note velocity from the voice (Dynamic) or always the Fixed velocity.
parameters.sound: Dynamic plays soft singing softly; Fixed gives every note the same strength.

parameters.name: Fixed velocity
parameters.description: The velocity of every note in Fixed mode, and the loudest in Dynamic
parameters.how: Sets the fixed velocity, and the loudest in Dynamic, from 1 to 127.
parameters.sound: Higher values play louder or brighter on most synths.

parameters.name: Softest velocity
parameters.description: Dynamic: the velocity of the softest note
parameters.how: Sets the velocity of the softest note in Dynamic mode, from 1 to 127.
parameters.sound: A higher minimum keeps soft notes audible.

parameters.name: Soft level
parameters.description: Dynamic: the voice level that gives the softest velocity
parameters.how: Sets the voice level, from -70 to -20 dB, that gives the softest velocity.
parameters.sound: Raise it if quiet singing plays too loud a note.

parameters.name: Loud level
parameters.description: Dynamic: the voice level that gives the loudest velocity
parameters.how: Sets the voice level, from -40 to 0 dB, that gives the loudest velocity.
parameters.sound: Lower it so ordinary singing reaches full velocity.

parameters.name: Min note length
parameters.description: A note lasts at least this long, however short the voice was
parameters.how: Sets the shortest a note lasts, from 0 to 100 ms mapped to 0 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Short sung notes still last long enough for the synth to sound.

parameters.name: Legato
parameters.description: A new note starts before the old one stops (for mono synths with legato), instead of after
parameters.how: Starts a new note before the old one stops when switched on.
parameters.sound: Mono synths then glide between notes instead of retriggering.

parameters.name: Pitch channel
parameters.description: MIDI channel of the pitch notes
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI channel of the pitch notes, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: It selects which synth or part plays the sung line.

parameters.name: Triggers
parameters.description: Trained sounds play notes
parameters.how: Switches the trained sounds playing notes on or off.
parameters.sound: Off leaves only the pitch part.

parameters.name: Window
parameters.description: The slice of each hit the classifier hears: Fast 18 ms (about 15 ms after the hit) or Accurate 30 ms (about 27 ms, a few points more right)
parameters.how: Chooses the slice of each hit the classifier hears: Fast (18 ms) or Accurate (30 ms).
parameters.sound: Accurate names sounds a few points more reliably and plays about 12 ms later.

parameters.name: Sensitivity
parameters.description: How soft a hit may be and still count (the onset threshold)
parameters.how: Sets how soft a hit may be and still count, from 0 to 100%.
parameters.sound: Higher values catch quiet hits and risk catching breaths and clicks.

parameters.name: Min gap
parameters.description: The shortest time between two hits. 100 to 120 ms suits a voice (the vowel after a consonant is not a second hit)
parameters.how: Sets the shortest time between two hits, from 60 to 300 ms.
parameters.sound: About 110 ms stops the vowel after a consonant counting as a second hit.

parameters.name: Overlap
parameters.description: Triggers win: a sound taken for a trigger does not also play a pitch note. Both: the voice also plays its pitch
parameters.how: Chooses whether a sound taken for a trigger also plays a pitch note: Triggers win or Both.
parameters.sound: Triggers win keeps a kick from also playing a low note; Both lets the voice play its pitch too.

parameters.name: Trigger length
parameters.description: How long each trigger note is held before its note off
parameters.how: Sets how long each trigger note is held, from 10 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Short notes suit drums that ring by themselves; long ones suit sustained sounds.

parameters.name: Trigger channel
parameters.description: MIDI channel of the trigger notes (10 is the drum channel)
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI channel of the trigger notes, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: Channel 10 is the drum channel of most drum machines.

parameters.name: Sound 1 note
parameters.description: MIDI note of sound 1 (Kick by default)
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI note sound 1 plays, from 0 to 127.
parameters.sound: Choose the drum or note you want that sound to play; defaults follow the usual drum map.

parameters.name: Sound 1 velocity
parameters.description: 0: from how hard the hit was. 1 to 127: always this velocity
parameters.how: Sets sound 1's velocity from 1 to 127, or 0 to take it from how hard the hit was.
parameters.sound: Zero makes harder hits play louder; a number makes every hit the same.

parameters.name: Sound 1 sensitivity
parameters.description: How sure the classifier must be for sound 1: higher plays more of the doubtful hits
parameters.how: Sets how sure the classifier must be to play sound 1, from 0 to 100%.
parameters.sound: Higher values play it more readily but let other sounds through as it; lower ones play only clear hits.

parameters.name: Chords
parameters.description: The pitch also plays a chord on its own channel
parameters.how: Switches the chords on or off.
parameters.sound: On, every sung note also plays a chord of the key on its own channel.

parameters.name: Chord follows
parameters.description: Root: the sung note is the chord's root (diatonic to the key). Melody: the chord of the key that fits the sung note
parameters.how: Chooses whether the sung note is the chord's root or the chord that fits the sung note is played.
parameters.sound: Root builds on the note you sing; Melody picks the chord of the key that contains it.

parameters.name: Chord type
parameters.description: Three or four notes
parameters.how: Chooses triads (three notes) or sevenths (four notes).
parameters.sound: Sevenths sound jazzier and richer; triads are plain and strong.

parameters.name: Inversion
parameters.description: Auto keeps the chords close to each other (smooth voice leading)
parameters.how: Chooses the chord's inversion: Root, First, Second or Auto.
parameters.sound: Auto keeps successive chords close together for smooth movement.

parameters.name: Voicing
parameters.description: Close: all within an octave. Open: the second note from the top an octave down. Wide: the root doubled an octave down
parameters.how: Chooses how the chord notes are spread: Close, Open or Wide.
parameters.sound: Close is tight and thick; Wide is airy and spread over more than an octave.

parameters.name: Chord octave
parameters.description: Register of the chords (0 is the octave of middle C minus one)
parameters.how: Sets the register of the chords, from -2 to +2 octaves.
parameters.sound: Lower registers make a pad under the voice; higher ones make a shimmer above.

parameters.name: Chord channel
parameters.description: MIDI channel of the chords
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI channel of the chords, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: It selects which synth or part plays the chords.

parameters.name: Chord velocity
parameters.description: The chords' velocity as a share of the pitch note's
parameters.how: Sets the chords' velocity as a share of the note's velocity, from 0 to 100%.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the chords behind the melody.

parameters.name: Level on
parameters.description: Level plays a controller
parameters.how: Switches the voice level playing a MIDI controller on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the voice level moves the controller's target, such as a filter or volume.

parameters.name: Level controller
parameters.description: The controller number of Level
parameters.how: Sets the controller number for the voice level, from 1 to 127.
parameters.sound: Pick the number the synth's target is mapped to (74 is often the filter cutoff).

parameters.name: Level min
parameters.description: Level at or under this gives the low end of the range (share of -60 to 0 dB)
parameters.how: Sets the amount of the voice level, from 0 to 100%, that gives the low end of the range.
parameters.sound: Raising it makes the controller reach its low value sooner.

parameters.name: Level max
parameters.description: Level at or over this gives the high end of the range (share of -60 to 0 dB)
parameters.how: Sets the amount of the voice level, from 0 to 100%, that gives the high end of the range.
parameters.sound: Lowering it makes the controller reach its high value sooner.

parameters.name: Level low value
parameters.description: The controller value at the min
parameters.how: Sets the controller value sent at the low end of the voice level, from 0 to 127.
parameters.sound: Swap it with the high value to turn the control upside down.

parameters.name: Level high value
parameters.description: The controller value at the max
parameters.how: Sets the controller value sent at the high end of the voice level, from 0 to 127.
parameters.sound: Lower it to limit how far the control moves its target.

parameters.name: Level channel
parameters.description: MIDI channel of Level
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI channel of the controller for the voice level, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: It selects which synth or part the control moves.

1 when the key in use is minor
